title: Set up Claude Code in your editor
intro: Pick your editor and see how to get started.

show.title: Install the extension
show.detail: The VS Code extension has its own chat panel and brings everything it needs.

trace.text: Install Claude Code from the Extensions view.
Open it from the Spark icon or with Cmd+Esc / Ctrl+Esc.
Option+K / Alt+K inserts a reference to your selection.

show.title: Install the CLI, then the plugin
show.detail: The JetBrains plugin connects to the claude command, so install that first.

trace.text: Install the Claude Code plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace and restart.
Run claude in the IDE's terminal; edits open in the IDE's diff view.

show.title: Connect with /ide
show.detail: Running in another terminal? Connect the session to your open IDE.

trace.text: Connects to the IDE: selections and diffs are shared.

quiz.question: What do you need before installing the JetBrains plugin?
quiz.explanation: Unlike the VS Code extension, the JetBrains plugin doesn't include the CLI, so install claude first.
